title: Muṭṭhassati
text: 4 Pañcahi Anuruddha dhammehi samannāgato mātu gāmo || la || nirayam upapajjati || katamehi pañcahi || || [page 243] XXXVII. 15. 6] PEYYĀLA-VAGGO DUTIYO 243 5 Assaddho ca hoti ahiriko ca hoti anottāpī ca hoti muṭṭhassati ca hoti duppañño ca hoti || || 6 Imehi kho Anuruddha pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo || la || nirayam upapajjatī ti || ||
